headlines.title: What sets AMD data centers apart as Intel stock keeps sliding?
headlines.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) outpaced Wall Street estimates for the chipmaker's third quarter earnings, carried by the company's AI data center revenue nearly doubling to $8.55 billion Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski helps The 8:30 team dive into and compare AMD's stock reaction to its data centers, while Intel (INTC) continues to plunge lower.

headlines.title: Nvidia is Far From The Only Threat to AMD
headlines.summary: Intel just posted its strongest data center growth in 15 years, and Broadcom is pulling AI budgets toward custom chips that undercut GPU pricing. AMD is fighting a two-front war it rarely gets credit for.

headlines.title: Intel Stock Down 47% Following Worst Day Since 1974. Is This a Buy-the-Dip Opportunity?
Intel Just Delivered Its Strongest Data Center Growth in 15 Years. Its Comeback Is Gaining Momentum
headlines.summary: Intel's data center business just posted its best growth in over a decade, yet shares cratered in premarket trading on a combination of soft guidance and a factory incident. Here is why the selloff may be creating an opportunity most investors are missing.

headlines.title: Intel Joins Semiconductor Pathways Fund to Strengthen The U.S. Engineering Talent Pipeline
headlines.summary: Last Mile Education Fund today announced that Intel Corporation has joined the Semiconductor Pathways Fund, a national industry coalition investing in future engineers and technicians who are close to graduation but face financial barriers that could prevent them from finishing. Intel's participation adds to a shared effort to strengthen the U.S. semiconductor workforce by investing in students who are already close to entering it.

description: Intel Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, markets, sells, and services computing and related end products and services in the United States, Ireland, Israel, and internationally. It operates through three segments: CCG, DCAI, and Intel Foundry. The company offers client computing group products, including client and commercial CPUs, discrete client GPUs, edge computing, and connectivity products; data center and AI products, such as server CPUs, discrete GPUs, and networking products; and semiconductors comprising wafer fabrication, substrates, and other related products and services. It also provides driving assistance and self-driving solutions; and develops and manufactures multi-beam mask writing tools. The company sells its products through sales organizations, distributors, resellers, retailers, and OEM partners. It serves original equipment manufacturers, original design manufacturers, cloud service providers, and other manufacturers and service providers. Intel Corporation has a strategic collaboration with Infosys Limited to develop a multi-layer AI fabric that unifies infrastructure, models, data, applications, and workflows into a composable and agent-ready ecosystem. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
